title: Greer's 1993-95 recommendations to the Clinton administration

tellings.quote: Now, if you go back to 93,45, you'll see what I wrote to the Clinton administration. It was the same set of recommendations.

plain: Steven Greer, a man who collects witness accounts about UFOs, says that between 1993 and 1995 he wrote a set of recommendations to President Bill Clinton's administration in Washington. He says those were the same recommendations he makes today, which, if true, would mean he has been asking the government for the same steps for decades.
